findings.issue: Opened with 'Institutions are hedging differently from the crowd', but the cited headlines (Investopedia n0800 'Investors Flee Stocks', Reuters n1164 gold-ETF inflows) name investors and ETF flows, not institutions; the part named no analyst, bank or institution for an honest split and re-cited n0690 already used in What Is Driving It.
